title: Inference for Linear Systems with Unknown Coefficients
abstract: arXiv:2604.24904v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper considers the problem of testing whether there exists a solution satisfying known linear constraints to a linear system of equations. Importantly and in contrast to some prior work, we allow all parameters in the system of equations, including the slope coefficients, to be unknown. For this reason, we describe the linear system as having unknown (as opposed to known) coefficients. This hypothesis testing problem arises naturally when constructing confidence sets for possibly partially identified parameters in the analysis of nonparametric instrumental variables models, treatment effect models, and random coefficient models, among other settings. We begin our analysis by providing a novel characterization of the set of coefficient pairs for which the linear system is feasible. translated_title: 具有未知系数的线性系统的推断
translated_abstract: 本文考虑的问题是：检验一个线性方程组是否存在满足已知线性约束的解。重要的是，与一些先前的研究不同，我们允许方程组中的所有参数（包括斜率系数）都是未知的。因此，我们将该线性系统描述为具有未知（而非已知）系数的线性系统。这一假设检验问题在多种情形下自然出现，例如在非参数工具变量模型、处理效应模型和随机系数模型等分析中，为可能仅被部分识别的参数构造置信集时。我们首先对线性系统可行的系数对集合提供了一种新颖的刻画。利用这一刻画，我们开发了一种基于样本分割的检验程序，并在弱且可解释的条件下建立了该检验的有效性。
tldr: 本文针对包括斜率系数在内所有参数均未知的线性方程组，提出检验其是否存在满足已知线性约束之解的方法，通过对可行系数对集合的新颖刻画以及基于样本分割的检验程序，在弱条件下建立了检验的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sample-splitting-based test for whether a linear system with fully unknown coefficients (including slopes) admits a solution satisfying known linear constraints, establishing validity under weak conditions via a novel characterization of the set of feasible coefficient pairs.
